subject: math
question:
设 $f(x), g(x)$ 是 $[0,1] \to [0,1]$ 的连续函数，且 $f(x)$ 单调递增，证明：

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (g (x)) \mathrm{d} x \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (x) \mathrm{d} x \cdot
$$

steps.text:
分析（1）令 $F(x) = f(x) - x$ ，则问题转化为证明 $\int_0^1 [F(g(x)) - F(x)]\mathrm{d}x\leqslant \int_0^1 x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}$ . 这只需证明 $\max_{0\leqslant x\leqslant 1}F(x) - \int_0^1 F(x)\mathrm{d}x\leqslant \frac{1}{2}$ ，即 $\int_0^1 F(x)\mathrm{d}x\geqslant \max_{0\leqslant x\leqslant 1}F(x) - \frac{1}{2}$ .

（2）由积分中值定理 $\int_0^1 [f(g(x)) - g(x)]\mathrm{d}x = f(g(\xi)) - g(\xi)$ ，只需证明 $\forall t\in (0,1)$ ，有

$$
f (t) - t \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \cdot
$$

方法1 令 $F(x) = f(x) - x$ ，记 $\max_{0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1} F(x) = F(x_0) = a$ 。由于 $0 \leqslant f(x) \leqslant 1$ ，则 $-x \leqslant F(x) \leqslant 1 - x$ ，所以 $a \leqslant 1 - x_0$ 。

因为 $f(x)$ 单调递增，当 $x \in [x_0, 1]$ 时， $f(x) \geqslant f(x_0)$ ，即 $F(x) + x \geqslant F(x_0) + x_0 = a + x_0$ 。所以

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} F (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} F (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {x _ {0}} ^ {1} F (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} (- x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {x _ {0}} ^ {1} (a + x _ {0} - x) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = a - \frac {1}{2} + x _ {0} (1 - a - x _ {0}) \geqslant a - \frac {1}{2} = \max _ {0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1} F (x) - \frac {1}{2} \\ & \geqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} F (g (x)) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (g (x)) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (x) \mathrm{d} x - \frac {1}{2}. \end{array}
$$

将 $F(x) = f(x) - x$ 代入左端积分式，即得所证不等式.

方法2 $\int_0^1 f(g(x))\mathrm{d}x - \int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x = \int_0^1 [f(g(x)) - g(x)]\mathrm{d}x = f(g(\xi)) - g(\xi)(0 <   \xi <  1).$

记 $g(\xi) = t$ ，因为 $0 \leqslant f(x) \leqslant 1$ ， $0 \leqslant g(x) \leqslant 1$ ，且 $f(x)$ 单调递增，则有

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (g (x)) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (x) \mathrm{d} x = f (t) - t \leqslant f (t) (1 - t) \\ = \int_ {t} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} x \leqslant \int_ {t} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x. \end{array}
$$
